verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises a full HTTP API and SDK reference plus webhooks, implying substantial API coverage, but there is no evidence confirming feature parity with the UI (e.g., no OpenAPI spec found, no explicit list of API-exposed actions like roadmap voting, workflows, or changelog publishing). missing for 10: OpenAPI/spec confirming full endpoint coverage, explicit parity claims or examples showing UI-only features (workflows, roadmap, changelog styling) are also API-accessible, independent verification of API completeness.
